summary: Master liquidity risk and funding management with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with the skills to navigate financial challenges confidently
lede: Liquidity risk management training helps treasury and risk professionals assess an institution’s ability to meet obligations as they fall due. Learners build cash-flow ladders using contractual and behavioral assumptions, calculate liquidity coverage and stable funding measures, and test funding capacity through stress scenarios and survival-horizon analysis. They also develop early-warning triggers, contingency funding actions, and reporting dashboards to support liquidity decisions.
audienceIntro: This liquidity risk management course is designed for professionals who measure cash-flow exposure, control funding capacity, oversee liquidity governance, or rely on liquidity reports for balance-sheet decisions.
modules: Liquidity Risk Management and Basel III
Funding Strategy and Funds Transfer Pricing
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of treasury, financial risk, asset-liability management, finance, or regulatory reporting. Familiarity with balance sheets, cash-flow concepts, and spreadsheet formulas will help you complete the calculation exercises. The course requires no programming or coding. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted forecasting, reverse stress testing, and ILAAP receive conceptual awareness and operational application coverage, while LCR, NSFR, cash-flow ladders, stress scenarios, and dashboards receive hands-on practice.
